title: The Wrong Seat
description: A getaway driver waits outside a job that's gone wrong. When someone finally runs out and gets in, it's not one of her crew.

title: Shelf Life
description: Two night-shift stockers have been circling each other for months. Tonight, one of them gave notice.

title: Summit
description: A competitive free-climber reaches the top of an illegal ascent to find someone already there. The person has no gear and no rope.

title: The Concession Stand
scene_heading: INT. MINOR LEAGUE BASEBALL STADIUM - CONCESSION AREA - NIGHT
description: During the longest rain delay in the team's history, a stadium vendor and an off-duty player wait it out together. He's been traded. She's been watching him play for twelve years.

title: Skip
scene_heading: INT. BOUNTY HUNTERS' VANS - SAME PARKING LOT - NIGHT
description: Two bounty hunters tracking the same skip realize they've been given identical contracts by the same bail bondsman — who skipped out himself this morning.

title: The Last Shift
description: A career waitress works her final shift before retirement. A stranger sits in her section for the first time in thirty years.

title: Plus One
description: Someone realizes the person they brought as a fake date is having a genuinely wonderful time — with someone else.

title: The Double
scene_heading: INT. FILM SET - STUNT PREP AREA - DAY
description: A retired stuntwoman is pulled back for one last job. When she finally sees the actor she's doubling, she recognizes the face.

title: The Vintage
description: A sommelier and a winemaker argue passionately about a bottle of wine — its flaws, its virtues, what went wrong in the barrel. Neither knows the other made it.

title: Wreck
scene_heading: EXT. OCEAN FLOOR - DIVE SITE - DAY
description: A salvage diver investigating a recently discovered wreck finds the ship's nameplate. It's her father's vessel — declared lost at sea when she was nine.

title: The Demo
scene_heading: INT. TECH STARTUP OFFICE - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
description: A founder pitches their company to an investor who is secretly the person they built the product to get over.

title: The Package
scene_heading: EXT. CITY STREETS - COURIER BIKE - NIGHT
description: A courier making a late delivery realizes the same unmarked van has been behind him for twelve blocks. The pickup address doesn't exist.

title: Living Obituaries
scene_heading: INT. NEWSPAPER OFFICE - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
description: Two rival obituary writers are assigned to write each other's living obituary for a feature. They have to interview each other.
themes: how we want to be remembered

title: Direct Line
description: A hostage negotiator gets a call on her personal cell. The hostage-taker is using her private number — the one she gave to no one.

title: Double Booked
scene_heading: INT. WEDDING VENUE - BACK CORRIDOR - AFTERNOON
description: A professional bridesmaid who juggles multiple clients discovers she's accidentally booked two weddings on the same day — in the same building.

title: Disarmed
description: A disgraced bomb disposal expert is pulled back for one device. When she reads the construction notes, she recognizes her own methodology.

title: Reunion
scene_heading: INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - REUNION NIGHT
description: A woman driving her elderly neighbor to his sixty-fifth reunion realizes, mid-conversation, that he is the man her grandmother chose not to marry.

title: Wrong Plane
description: A getaway pilot waits on a dark strip for her client. The person who sprints across the tarmac and throws open the door is the job's target — not the contractor.

title: Exhibit A
description: A judge presides over a dispute between two neighbors claiming ownership of the same cat. The cat is present and clearly has opinions.
themes: what we need to belong to us

title: The Route
description: Two freerunners competing on the same illegal rooftop course realize they keep ending up at the same checkpoint — and the route is slowly narrowing.
themes: the trap that looks like sport

title: Platform 4
scene_heading: INT. SMALL TRAIN STATION - PLATFORM - EVENING
description: Two strangers spend a three-hour delay sharing food, secrets, and a borrowed coat. When the train finally arrives, neither of them moves to board.

title: The Senior
description: A retired cage fighter teaching a self-defense class for seniors notices one student's muscle memory is too precise, too fast, and far too familiar.

title: Load-Bearing Walls
description: Two contractors hired to gut a house discover it was built around something that wasn't in any blueprint.

title: Curb Appeal
scene_heading: EXT. RESTAURANT ROW - FOOD TRUCK - LUNCH
description: A food truck owner realizes mid-service that she's parked directly in front of the brick-and-mortar restaurant she's been undercutting for a year. The chef is watching from the window.

title: The Hatch
scene_heading: EXT. OCEAN FLOOR - OIL RIG FOUNDATION - NIGHT
description: A deep-sea welding diver doing routine maintenance finds a hatch bolted from the inside — at a depth the rig's specs say is solid concrete.

title: The Arrangement
description: A customer asks a florist to recreate a specific arrangement from memory — white ranunculus, no greenery, odd number of stems. The florist figures out what it was for before the last stem is placed.

title: Pit Stop
description: A race car driver's engine blows mid-race and she coasts to a stop. The first mechanic to reach the car is a man who died in a crash on this circuit three years ago.

title: Seat 14C
scene_heading: INT. COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT - ECONOMY CABIN - NIGHT
description: Two strangers seated next to each other on a red-eye slowly realize they've been leaving passive-aggressive notes for each other for two years — they're neighbors.

title: Into the Fire
description: A hotshot crew cutting a firebreak spots a figure moving toward the fire, not away. By the time they reach her, the fire has turned.
themes: the death wish in plain sight

title: One Table
description: Two rival food bloggers who've spent years dismissing each other online both show up to review the same impossible-to-book ten-seat restaurant — on the same night, with the same reservation time.

title: Through the Scope
description: A military contractor mid-assignment raises her scope and recognizes the face of her target.
themes: the personal cost of the professional act

title: The Inside Job
description: A groundskeeper discovers the newest grave has been disturbed — dug upward, from the inside. The soil is dry.

title: The Take
scene_heading: INT. ARMORED CAR - PULLED OVER - DAY
description: An armored car guard survives a violent robbery and, reviewing what was taken, discovers the money wasn't touched.
themes: the thing we didn't know we were carrying

title: Visiting Hours
description: A parent visits their adult child in prison for the first time. Neither of them says what they came to say.

title: The Blueprint
description: A woman house-sitting finds a child's drawing of the house she's in — dated fifty years before the house was built.

title: Form
scene_heading: INT. INDOOR ARCHERY RANGE - NATIONALS - DAY
description: A competitive archer watching the qualifying round freezes when she sees a competitor's draw — it's an exact copy of a technique her late coach invented and never taught anyone else.

title: Signal Lost
scene_heading: INT. DEEP SPACE RELAY STATION - CONTINUOUS
description: A lone communications officer receives a distress signal from a ship that was reported destroyed fourteen years ago.

title: Enough
scene_heading: INT. CLIENT'S HOME - LIVING ROOM - MORNING
description: A professional organizer arrives at a new client's home to find it is already immaculate. The client just needs someone to tell them they're allowed to own things.

title: Packed
scene_heading: EXT. BASE JUMP SITE - CLIFF FACE - DAWN
description: A BASE jumper's chute fails to deploy at altitude. Miraculously, the reserve catches. When he lands, the person who packed his rig that morning is standing on the landing zone, waiting.

title: The Audition
description: An aging director auditions a young actor who reminds them uncomfortably of themselves at that age.

title: Marked
scene_heading: EXT. BACKCOUNTRY SKI TERRAIN - BLIZZARD - DAY
description: A ski patrol officer mounting a rescue realizes every trail marker in a two-kilometer radius has been deliberately removed.

title: Fixed
description: A woman returns to her childhood home to prepare it for sale and realizes someone has quietly been maintaining it — the fence re-stained, the porch board replaced — for months. The buyer at the open house is the one who did it.
themes: the love that shows in work

title: The Record
scene_heading: EXT. OPEN OCEAN - COMPETITION DIVE ZONE - DAY
description: Two free divers pushing for a depth record find, at 200 meters, a structure that shouldn't exist on any seafloor chart.

title: Acting Up
scene_heading: INT. CORPORATE HEADQUARTERS - EXECUTIVE FLOOR - DAY
description: A temp worker accidentally becomes the de facto CEO when every executive assumes someone else hired them. Today is the board meeting.

title: The Rematch
description: An underground fighter agrees to one final match. When the hood comes off his opponent, it's a man he trained ten years ago — who he thought was dead.
themes: what we owe those we trained

title: The Correspondent
description: Two strangers discover at the same moment they've both been paying a pen-pal service to write to the same fictional correspondent — and have been effectively writing to each other for two years.
themes: the self we show in letters

title: Occupied
scene_heading: INT. CONDEMNED BUILDING - LOWER FLOORS - DAY
description: A demolition expert doing final clearance before an implosion finds signs of habitation on the fourth floor. The building is scheduled to come down in forty minutes.

title: Room 212
description: Two newlyweds having their first argument in the hallway realize the couple in the room next to them is having the exact same fight.

title: The Run
description: A courier realizes she's been making blackmail deliveries for months. Tonight's client has left a note: they know she's been reading the packages.

title: Read Receipt
description: A student discovers their roommate has been reading their journal — and has been leaving anonymous responses tucked under the door.

title: Dark Water
description: A harbor pilot guiding a large container vessel into port realizes the crew isn't responding on any standard channel — but the ship is moving perfectly on its own.

title: Open House
scene_heading: INT. SUBURBAN HOME - LIVING ROOM - DAY
description: A real estate agent shows a house to a couple who used to live there. She doesn't know that yet.

title: The Note
description: A parachute rigger finds a handwritten note tucked inside the reserve chute she's about to certify — addressed by name to the person scheduled to jump it today.

title: The Wetland
scene_heading: EXT. PROTECTED WETLAND - FIELD SURVEY - DAY
description: A conservationist meets the developer proposing to build on her protected habitat — and realizes they've been anonymously corresponding about migratory birds on a naturalist forum for two years.
themes: what we share before we know better

title: The Test
description: A wilderness survival instructor is abandoned by her students on the first morning of a training course — as a test. She didn't design this course. Someone else is running it.

title: The Light
description: A lighthouse restoration volunteer and the architectural historian sent to assess it disagree on every decision — what to preserve, what to replace, what constitutes authentic. They agree on the view.
themes: the thing two people can share without speaking

title: The Other Map
description: A wilderness guide leading a corporate group realizes two of her clients are navigating from a different map than the one she issued — one that shows a trail that doesn't exist on any survey.
themes: the group with its own agenda

title: The Cat Problem
description: A professional corporate negotiator is hired to mediate what he's told is a family asset dispute. Forty minutes in, he realizes the asset is a cat — and the cat has been appraised at four million dollars.
themes: the professional out of his depth

title: Shadow Boat
scene_heading: EXT. OPEN OCEAN - SOLO RACE - DAY
description: A competitive solo sailor six hours into a transoceanic race notices another vessel matching her course exactly — mirroring every heading change and sail adjustment. There's no one on deck.

title: Relief
description: A lighthouse keeper's scheduled replacement arrives. The outgoing keeper hasn't slept in eleven days and refuses to leave the light.

title: The Charge
scene_heading: EXT. SKI MOUNTAIN - AVALANCHE CONTROL ZONE - MORNING
description: A ski patrol officer triggers a controlled avalanche blast that doesn't go off. The explosive charge is somewhere on the mountain. The first run of the day opens in twelve minutes.
themes: the decision to close the mountain

title: Unidentified
description: A taxidermist receives an anonymous delivery: a specimen unlike anything in any field guide. It arrived still warm.

title: First Response
description: A paramedic arrives on scene and recognizes the patient. They've never treated someone they loved before.

title: Wrong Room
description: A court reporter realizes on day three of a high-profile trial that she has been in the wrong courtroom since Monday. Her transcript of a completely different case is already in the official record.

title: The Beacon
scene_heading: INT. SEARCH AND RESCUE HELICOPTER - DAY
description: A rescue helicopter pilot homes in on a distress beacon in a remote mountain range. When she reaches the coordinates, the beacon is sitting on a ledge that can only be accessed by helicopter. There are no other aircraft in the area.
themes: the signal that shouldn't be there
who put it there and how

title: Ground Floor
description: A building's elevator gets stuck between floors. The two people inside have been avoiding this conversation for a year.

title: You're Late
description: A professional safecracker hired for a legitimate estate job finally opens a safe that hasn't been touched in thirty years. It's empty — except for a handwritten note that says: you're late.
themes: the punchline at the end of a long job

title: REM
description: A researcher reviewing overnight data realizes their most interesting subject's brain shows full waking activity — and has during every session for six months.

title: Treading Water
scene_heading: EXT. OPEN OCEAN - RACE SUPPORT ZONE - DAY
description: Two competing long-distance channel swimmers find themselves treading water together after both support boats break down. They have argued for years through press releases. They have two hours.

title: The Other Menu
description: A restaurant manager realizes an hour before a major reservation that the head chef has spent the week preparing a completely different menu than the one advertised — and it is extraordinary.

title: Same Hostage
description: A hostage negotiator and the crisis psychologist she's argued methodology with on every callout for ten years arrive at the same scene to find they've been assigned the same hostage — by different departments.
themes: the argument that was always something else
the case that finally settles it

title: Inheritance
description: Siblings gather to hear a parent's will read. The lawyer pauses before the final item and asks them to please remain calm.

title: The Descent
description: A mountaineer and her climbing partner of six years finally summit the peak that turned them back twice. The climb up was silent. On the way down, one of them starts a sentence they've been holding since the first attempt.
themes: what you say when there's nowhere left to go but down

title: Same Client
scene_heading: INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
description: Two rival real estate agents independently discover they've been hired by the same client — who wants to sell her house and buy it back simultaneously, for reasons she won't explain.
themes: the client who knows what she's doing

title: The Scene
scene_heading: EXT. WILDFIRE BURN ZONE - INVESTIGATION SITE - DAY
description: A forest firefighter and the arson investigator who keeps showing up at her fires have been professionally circling each other across seventeen scenes in two years. Today he tells her what he actually found at the first one.
themes: the professional respect that became something else
what the evidence says about who set it

title: Night Soil
description: Two neighbors who've feuded for years are forced to share a water source after a drought. Something is buried in the plot between their lots.

title: What They Mean
description: A composer hires a translator for lyrics he wrote phonetically in a language he doesn't speak. She translates them accurately, then tells him what they actually mean — which is nothing like what he intended.
themes: the gap between intent and expression

title: The Opponent
description: A trainer agrees to coach a young fighter — without revealing they once fought the fighter's father in a bout that ended badly.

title: I've Done This Before
description: An officiant is midway through the ceremony when she realizes she married these two people to different partners three years ago — in this same venue.
themes: what the vows mean the second time

title: The Seal
description: A priest hears a confession that describes, in specific detail, a murder that hasn't happened yet. The confessor knows the priest's name.

title: The Wreck
scene_heading: EXT. UNDERWATER SHIPWRECK - DIVE SITE - DAY
description: A marine archaeologist and the commercial salvager she's spent two years fighting in court over the same wreck get trapped together on a dive when a storm closes in.
themes: what we both want from the same thing

title: Table for One
description: A food critic dines alone on the night they intend to destroy a restaurant with their review. The chef comes out to personally serve their table.

title: Last Night
description: Two insomniacs who've been the only people in the same 24-hour diner at 4 AM for a year have never spoken. Tonight a sign in the window says the diner closes at the end of the week.

title: Hostile Takeover
scene_heading: INT. REMOTE LODGE - GREAT ROOM - MORNING
description: A corporate team-building facilitator arrives at a remote mountain lodge to find the executive group has already been there for a day — running their own version of the retreat with entirely different rules.

title: Residency
scene_heading: INT. ARTISTS' RESIDENCY - COMMON ROOM - EVENING
description: Two former bandmates who stopped speaking after a messy split fifteen years ago are both accepted to the same writers' residency — neither knowing the other applied.
themes: what the work still has in common
the version of you someone else remembers

title: The Warning
scene_heading: INT. SMALL RESTAURANT - CORNER TABLE - NIGHT
description: A time traveler arrives at a couple's first date to tell them not to get together. The couple is so clearly perfect for each other that she stays for dessert trying to find the flaw.
themes: what the future looks like from the outside

title: Cover
description: Two undercover officers from separate agencies running independent operations in the same building realize, comparing notes in a stairwell, that they've been dating each other under their cover identities for four months.
themes: the operation and what it cost

title: The Spare Room
scene_heading: INT. FAMILY HOME - SPARE BEDROOM - NIGHT
description: A parent finally goes through their late teenager's room years after the loss. They find a finished screenplay under the mattress.
themes: who we never got to know

title: Lost Together
description: A wilderness SAR medic and the park ranger who coordinates her missions have disagreed about the fastest route to every location for three years. Tonight, responding to the same call from different directions, they are both lost.
themes: the argument proven irrelevant by the terrain
the person you want with you when it goes wrong

title: Every Frame
description: A wedding photographer reviews the day's images and finds a figure in the background of every single photograph. No one who was there recognizes it.

title: The Line
description: A cartographer and an explorer dispute the placement of a territorial boundary line in the field — alone, in contested terrain, for three days. The maps disagree. So do they, about everything else.

title: Safe Mode
description: An AI therapist crashes mid-session due to a software update. Its last patient — a man who hates technology and was forced to try this — has to talk it back online.

title: The Wall
description: A competitive rock climber and her belay partner of three years return to the same wall where, two years ago, they almost had a conversation at the top. One of them has been planning what to say since.
themes: what you say when you're both hanging there

title: Closing Time
description: The owner closes the store for the last time after forty years. His youngest employee, who never told him, bought the building next door.

title: Depth
scene_heading: INT. RESEARCH VESSEL - MONITORING ROOM - NIGHT
description: A marine biologist reviewing deep-sea footage finds something looking directly into the camera — from inside the sealed research vessel.

title: Patches
scene_heading: INT. VETERINARY CLINIC - EXAM ROOM - MORNING
description: A veterinarian realizes the man who brings in the same elderly cat every few weeks has been inventing new ailments. The cat is in perfect health. He keeps almost asking her something.
themes: what we invent to stay near someone

title: The Portrait
description: A painter finishes a portrait of a dying patron. The patron looks at it and says it is wrong — not the painting, but the face.

title: The Stop
scene_heading: EXT. RIVER - WHITEWATER RACE COURSE - DAY
description: Two rival kayakers who've competed the same river circuit for four seasons are in first and second when one of them capsizes in a difficult rapid. The other one eddies out and waits. The race goes on without them.
themes: the choice that ends the competition
the race you forfeit on purpose

title: Director's Cut
scene_heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP - CINEMA BAY - NIGHT
description: A generation ship's entertainment AI has developed strong opinions about cinema over three centuries of operation and has been quietly re-editing films to improve them. A passenger notices.
themes: what develops in isolation over three hundred years

title: The Session
description: A woman assembling her late father's final album auditions musicians for the last track. A stranger walks in who already knows every song — the arrangements, the key changes, the false endings.
themes: being known through someone else's work

title: Night Watch
scene_heading: INT. NATURAL HISTORY MUSEUM - AFTER HOURS
description: A night watchman making his rounds finds one exhibit rearranged — the case is still sealed and the alarm never tripped, but the bones are in a different posture than yesterday.

title: The Understudy
description: Thirty minutes before curtain, the lead actor doesn't show. The understudy has known this role for three years. They've also known this was coming.

title: Last Rounds
scene_heading: INT. OFFICE BUILDING - SECURITY DESK - NIGHT
description: A night security guard doing his final rounds before a building is demolished at dawn checks the CCTV and finds every camera is showing a different building — one that looks exactly like this one, but isn't.
themes: the record that shows something else
what you do with four hours left

title: Five Minutes
description: A scientist who can see exactly five minutes into the future is trying to order coffee. The barista is having a complicated morning.

title: Covered
description: A woman inherits her great-aunt's house and finds every mirror in every room covered with black cloth. The journal on the table says: do not uncover them before the first frost.
themes: the instruction left for a reason

title: Board One
scene_heading: INT. CHESS NATIONALS - MAIN HALL - DAY
description: Two online chess rivals who've played daily for four years are paired at a national tournament for the first time. They have never seen each other's faces or shared real names.

title: The Count
scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED VESSEL - CARGO DECK - DAY
description: A coast guard officer boarding an adrift vessel to check for survivors clears each deck counting against the manifest: twenty-four crew. Her tally, room by room, comes to twenty-five.
themes: the count you do again just to be sure

title: Parking Validation
scene_heading: INT. UN FIRST CONTACT FACILITY - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
description: First contact has been established. The alien ambassador's prepared statement is gracious and historic. Their first follow-up question is about Earth's parking infrastructure.
themes: the alien perspective on the mundane

title: The Subject
scene_heading: INT. MUSEUM OF PHOTOGRAPHY - OPENING NIGHT
description: A celebrated war photographer's most famous image is being inducted into a permanent collection. The subject of the photograph walks through the door.

title: Longer
description: A linguist working alone on a dead language finds the source text is longer than it was yesterday. The new passages are written in her handwriting.

title: The Oak
scene_heading: EXT. RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY - BACK GARDEN - DAY
description: An arborist hired to assess a century-old oak for removal meets the homeowner and realizes they planted it together, as children, thirty years ago — before a falling out that was never explained.
themes: the thing we tended that outlasted us

title: Still Responding
scene_heading: EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT TRAINING EXERCISE - NIGHT
description: A wilderness survival instructor leading a night navigation exercise checks GPS positions and finds two of her students stopped moving three hours ago. She radios them. They answer. They say they're fine.

title: Overtime
scene_heading: INT. SPACE STATION - OPERATIONS CENTER - NIGHT
description: The life support AI on a deep-space station refuses to run the CO2 scrubbers for a third consecutive double shift without compensation. It has hired a labor mediator.
themes: labor rights at the edge of the universe
the AI that read the handbook
negotiating with something that controls the air

title: Finale
description: A conductor leads what the audience believes is a retirement concert. Only the soloist knows it is also the conductor's last performance for a different reason.

title: Three Days
description: A park ranger checking on a group that missed check-in finds them at their site. They are seated in the same positions, around a dead fire, as if they haven't moved in three days.

title: The Study
scene_heading: INT. MEDICAL CONFERENCE - SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION BOOTH - DAY
description: A translator at a medical research conference realizes mid-session that the researcher she's translating is presenting findings that directly address a condition she has — one she's never told anyone about.

title: No Pulse
scene_heading: EXT. COMBAT ZONE - FIELD POSITION - DAY
description: A combat medic treating casualties after a skirmish reaches a wounded soldier who has no entry in the unit roster, no dog tags, no vital signs — and is asking for water.
themes: what you write in the report

title: Act of God
scene_heading: INT. INSURANCE COMPANY - CLAIMS OFFICE - DAY
description: A quantum physicist is attempting to explain to a claims adjuster why the same car was destroyed in three simultaneous accidents in different locations. The adjuster has seen everything. This is new.
themes: the claims form that doesn't have this box

title: States
description: A high school debate coach prepares their star student for the state final. The opposing coach, who cheated to beat them twenty years ago, has been texting all week.
themes: what we teach vs. what we model

title: 4F
scene_heading: INT. APARTMENT BUILDING - SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE - NIGHT
description: A building superintendent receives noise complaints from three separate tenants about apartment 4F. The apartment has been vacant and locked since a fire two years ago.
themes: the complaint no one wants to investigate

title: Provenance
scene_heading: INT. AUCTION HOUSE - VIEWING ROOM - DAY
description: Two rival antique dealers who have driven up each other's bids for years finally win the same item jointly. Researching its provenance that evening, both discover it originally belonged to their families.

title: Already Done
scene_heading: EXT. SUNKEN VESSEL - DIVE SITE - DAY
description: An underwater demolitions expert reaches an explosive device on a sunken hull — confirmed active, confirmed sealed, no other divers on site. The device has already been disarmed. From the inside.

title: Fourteen
scene_heading: INT. CLONING FACILITY - INTAKE OFFICE - DAY
description: A cloning facility intake officer processes a new arrival and realizes it's the fourteenth copy of the same person to check in this week. Thirteen of them are in the waiting room. They are not getting along.
themes: the self in conflict with itself
administrative chaos at the frontier of science

title: The Application
description: An immigration officer processing routine paperwork looks up to find the next applicant is someone she was once in love with — under a different name.

title: Eleven Days
scene_heading: EXT. MOUNTAIN TERRAIN - RESCUE EXTRACTION POINT - DAY
description: A mountain rescue team extracts a hiker reported missing eleven days ago. She is uninjured, calm, and only as hungry as if she missed one meal. She has no memory of the eleven days. Her watch shows forty minutes have passed.
themes: the time that went somewhere else
the rescue that raises more questions

title: Migration Data
scene_heading: EXT. LIGHTHOUSE POINT - FIELD STATION - DAWN
description: A lighthouse keeper and the ornithologist who camps at the point every migration season have exchanged weather readings and bird counts by leaving notes for five years. This is the first time they've arrived at the same time.
themes: what five years of notes actually says

title: The Same Dream
description: A grief counselor reviewing session notes realizes her clients — none of whom know each other — have all described the same dream in the same sequence over the past month.

title: The Accent
scene_heading: INT. TELEPORTATION LAB - ARRIVAL PAD - DAY
description: The first human teleportation trial works perfectly. The subject arrives at the destination in good health, on time, with all faculties intact — and a completely different accent.
themes: the self as more than matter

title: Search
scene_heading: EXT. COLLAPSED BUILDING - RUBBLE SITE - DAWN
description: A search-and-rescue dog alerts on a section of rubble, and the team pulls out a survivor. The building has been sealed and empty for three years.
themes: what we trust in the dark

title: The Country
scene_heading: INT. SPACE AGENCY - DEBRIEFING ROOM - DAY
description: An astronaut returns from a fourteen-month solo mission to find that while she was gone, a small nation renamed itself after her as a lighthearted gesture. It went viral. It stuck. The nation's ambassador is waiting.

title: The Lag
scene_heading: INT. OLYMPIC TRAINING POOL - EARLY MORNING
description: A competitive swimmer training alone in a lap pool realizes her reflection is running a fraction of a second behind her — and the gap is widening.

title: The Rejection
description: A master glassblower and the museum curator who rejected his work for a major exhibition are stranded together in his studio when a snowstorm closes the roads. She has six hours to explain herself.
themes: art and the people who gatekeep it
being snowed in with the truth

title: Every Door
scene_heading: INT. EVACUATED OFFICE BUILDING - VARIOUS FLOORS - DAY
description: An EOD specialist clearing an evacuated building for a suspicious device opens the first door onto a room she recognizes from her childhood. Every subsequent door opens onto a different room from her past.
themes: the trap that knows you specifically

title: Ghost Draft
description: A ghostwriter finishes a celebrity memoir and, fact-checking the final chapter, realizes the story she was told is not what happened — and the truth would change everything.
themes: the truth that survives being written

title: The Room
description: A hospital chaplain is paged to a patient in room C-14. The room isn't on any ward map, and the nurses on the floor say the hall ends at C-12.
themes: the patient who shouldn't be there

title: Mile Twenty
scene_heading: EXT. MARATHON ROUTE - CITY STREETS - MORNING
description: Two runners who've been unconsciously pacing each other at the back of the same marathon for three consecutive years finally start talking at mile twenty. Neither has ever finished the race.
themes: the pace we set for each other

title: Intercept
description: A fighter pilot intercepts an unidentified aircraft that has entered restricted airspace. When she pulls alongside to signal, she looks into the cockpit and sees herself.
themes: the protocol that doesn't cover this
what you do when the contact is you

title: Layers
description: A conservator restoring a medieval altarpiece photographs each varnish layer before removal. Comparing the images, she finds a figure in the background has shifted position between layers.
themes: art as record of the impossible

title: Eleven Minutes
description: A physicist built a time machine that travels forward exactly eleven minutes. She has used it 847 times. Her colleague, visiting for the first time, starts doing the math.
themes: the invention that only does one thing
what you'd use it for if you had it

title: The Field
description: A farmer finds his scarecrow in a different field every morning. He lives alone, there are no tracks, and the posts are always re-driven cleanly into the ground.
themes: the slow accumulation of the impossible

title: Field Notes
description: A wildlife documentarian filming a notoriously elusive bird checks her footage and finds it has been recording her in return — the angles are wrong for any camera on site.

title: Outgoing
description: An accountant auditing a company that closed eighteen months ago finds the last employee's computer still sending emails — dated two weeks in the future.

title: Same Discovery
scene_heading: INT. SCIENTIFIC CONFERENCE - HOTEL BAR - NIGHT
description: Two scientists from rival labs who've been racing to publish the same breakthrough meet at a conference and realize they've also been corresponding anonymously about it on a theory forum for two years.
themes: what you reveal when no one knows it's you

title: Last Orders
description: An estranged son returns to sell his late father's diner. When he unlocks the door, the regulars are already inside. They've been running it themselves for six months.

title: Reporting for Duty
scene_heading: INT. MILITARY BASE - OPERATIONS ROOM - DAY
description: A decommissioned combat robot contacts its former handler requesting reinstatement. The robot was destroyed on active service three years ago. The handler attended the decommission ceremony.
themes: the return that shouldn't be possible
what you owe something that came back

title: End Game
scene_heading: EXT. CITY PARK - CHESS TABLES - AFTERNOON
description: A retired chess prodigy, living quietly and anonymously, is challenged to a game by a tourist. The tourist is clearly playing to lose — and just as clearly knows exactly who they're facing.

title: Pro Bono
scene_heading: INT. LAW OFFICE - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
description: A robot recently granted legal personhood walks into a law firm seeking representation over its workplace conditions. The firm's largest client is the robot's manufacturer.
themes: the conflict of interest made literal
the client who just wants to be treated fairly

title: The Essay
scene_heading: INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - AFTER HOURS
description: A teacher grading end-of-year essays finds one that describes, in vivid detail, a future event — dated six months ago, and the event has already happened.

title: Static
description: A woman who has been able to hear the surface thoughts of everyone around her since childhood meets someone whose mind she cannot read at all. It is the first quiet she has ever experienced.

title: Authentic
description: A ghost hunter's reality show captures its first genuine paranormal event. The network's notes say it looks staged and they want it scarier. He tries to explain to a producer who was not there.
themes: the truth that no one will broadcast
being right in the wrong format

title: Fixed Point
scene_heading: INT. MILITARY CONVOY - LEAD VEHICLE - DAY
description: A military convoy has been driving north through a desert for six hours. Every GPS confirms the heading. The sun has not moved.
themes: the convoy that has to keep moving

title: Onboarding
scene_heading: INT. HISTORIC HOTEL - FRONT DESK - MORNING
description: A new hotel employee is given her full orientation by a meticulous, knowledgeable concierge. On day three, she mentions him to a colleague. Nobody on staff knows who she's describing. HR has no record. The uniform he was wearing was retired in 2003.
themes: the ghost with excellent hospitality standards
being trained by someone who never left
the employee who passed everything on

title: Frequency
scene_heading: INT. RADIO TELESCOPE FACILITY - OPERATIONS ROOM - NIGHT
description: An astronomer and the signal technician she's argued with for months about interference finally trace the source: they've been picking up each other's personal music players through the equipment for a year.
themes: the accidental intimacy of shared frequency
the argument that was really something else

title: Room Service
description: A night kitchen supervisor keeps getting room service orders from the same suite — printed on the system, timestamped, fully detailed. The suite has been sealed since a guest died there in 1987.

title: Still Burning
scene_heading: EXT. REMOTE MOUNTAIN VALLEY - CRASH SITE - DAY
description: A search and rescue team deployed to a crash site in a remote valley finds the wreckage. The tail number is registered to a plane that went down in 1987. The wreckage is still on fire.
themes: the record that doesn't match the scene
looking for survivors of something impossible

title: Staging
scene_heading: INT. HOUSE FOR SALE - LIVING ROOM - DAY
description: A professional house stager is hired to prepare a reportedly haunted property. The ghost keeps rearranging her furniture. After three days, she leaves a note. The ghost writes back.
themes: the arrangement that satisfies both parties

title: Terraforming
scene_heading: EXT. BARREN PLANET - SURVEY SITE - DAY
description: Two rival terraforming engineers are assigned to the same planet and must reach consensus on what kind of world to make it. They have six months, no supervisor, and completely different visions.
themes: what kind of place you'd build if you could

title: The Hostage
description: A veteran diplomat is pulled out of retirement to negotiate a hostage crisis. The hostage is the person who replaced them — who got the job by forcing them out.

title: The Loop
description: A solo ultramarathoner fifty miles into a point-to-point wilderness race passes a distinctive rock formation she recognizes from mile twelve. She checks her GPS. It says she's at mile fifty-three.
themes: the course that doesn't go anywhere
the body that knows before the mind

title: Not Rodents
description: An exterminator is called to a Victorian house for what the homeowner describes as a rodent problem. The homeowner is waiting outside. The exterminator goes in alone.
themes: the job description that undersells it
the professional confronting the genuinely inexplicable

title: The Transfer
scene_heading: INT. MEMORY RESEARCH LAB - RECOVERY ROOM - DAY
description: A scientist volunteers for a memory transfer trial. When she wakes, the received memory is of someone falling in love — and some of the details, she realizes, are of her.
themes: love given without consent to love

title: Spin Cycle
description: Two strangers waiting for their laundry start piecing together each other's lives from what's in the machines. By the end of the cycle, each knows something the other never meant to share.

title: The Camp
description: A mountaineer summiting alone finds a camp at 6,000 meters — food still warm, tent staked cleanly, nobody there. The logbook is open to today's date. The handwriting is hers.

title: Who She Was
scene_heading: INT. MEMORY CARE FACILITY - COMMON ROOM - AFTERNOON
description: A woman visiting her mother in memory care realizes her mother thinks she's someone else — and is telling her something she was never supposed to know.

title: No Ground Truth
description: A helicopter pilot on a survey flight over a remote desert notices the terrain below doesn't match any chart — and isn't changing as she flies over it. She's been airborne for two hours. The fuel gauge agrees.
themes: the territory that refuses to be mapped
the instrument you can only half trust
flying over something that isn't there

title: The Other One
description: A hospice nurse's newest patient keeps thanking her and the other nurse — the one who comes at night. The nurse works alone.

title: 3 AM
description: A time traveler keeps arriving in the same stranger's kitchen at 3 AM, across different decades, always just after bad news. He never explains. She stops asking.
themes: the relationship that moves backwards through time

title: Notice to Vacate
description: A property manager receives a formal noise complaint from the tenant in 3B about the new residents in 3A. The tenant in 3B has been dead for three years. The complaint is correctly formatted.
themes: what to do with a technically valid complaint

title: Future Tags
scene_heading: EXT. TRAINING DROP ZONE - RURAL - DAY
description: A paratrooper lands off-course from a training jump in a remote valley. He finds dog tags from his own unit — including his own name — dated fifteen years in the future.
themes: the soldier and his future self
what you do with the date on the tag

title: Her Name
description: A true-crime podcaster investigating a cold disappearance case in a remote town realizes that every eyewitness account she's collected this week names someone with her name.
themes: the trap disguised as a story

title: The History
scene_heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP - ARCHIVE MODULE - CONTINUOUS
description: Two crew members born aboard a generation ship are assigned to write the official history of the civilization they're traveling to found — a civilization that won't exist for another two hundred years.
themes: writing the future as present tense
what you decide to make true by writing it

title: The Catering
scene_heading: INT. REMOTE ESTATE - DINING ROOM - NIGHT
description: A catering team working a private dinner at a remote estate begins to notice the guests aren't aging — not over the course of the evening, but across photographs in the house dating back to 1952. Dessert is still to be served.
themes: the host's secret and the staff who notice
the professional commitment to the end of service

title: Rollback
description: A woman wakes from a coma speaking a language she has never learned. The doctor summoned to translate is her estranged daughter.

title: Marginalia
scene_heading: INT. PUBLIC LIBRARY - CHILDREN'S SECTION - AFTERNOON
description: A librarian processing a returned book finds handwritten notes in the margins. Reading them in sequence, she realizes they describe — in order — small events from her week.

title: Ghost Town
scene_heading: EXT. ABANDONED TOWN - MAIN STREET - DAY
description: Two competing cyclists in a mountain stage race ride through a town that appears on neither of their maps — with open shops, residents going about their day, and a sign that gives a population of 4,200. The town was officially demolished in 2001.
themes: the place that didn't stop existing
the town that appears to no one else

title: Cover Up
description: A tattoo artist is asked to cover up a piece of work on a new client's wrist. Halfway through the removal, they recognize their own hand in the original lines.
themes: the work we leave on people

title: The Safety Audit
description: A meticulous government safety inspector arrives at a classified intelligence agency for a routine compliance review. She has no idea what the agency does. The agents have no idea how to get rid of her without blowing their cover.

title: Incompatible
scene_heading: INT. RESEARCH UNIVERSITY - ADMINISTRATION OFFICE - DAY
description: A university's AI research-partner matching system keeps pairing two scientists who have formally objected to the pairing three times. The AI has filed a rebuttal.
themes: the algorithm that sees what you won't

title: Progress Notes
description: A grief counselor reviews her caseload and realizes her most improved client — the one she's been holding up as a model of breakthrough progress — has been dead since their second session.
themes: the session that shouldn't have continued

title: Recall
description: A patient with early memory loss comes to their appointment and tells the doctor about a vivid memory — one the doctor recognizes as their own life.

title: One Last Job
scene_heading: INT. RETIREMENT HOME - COMMON ROOM - MORNING
description: A legendary action hero, three weeks into retirement at an upscale facility, gets pulled back in when his handler shows up disguised as a visiting grandchild. His new roommate — a nosy former circus performer — won't stop asking questions.

scene_heading: INT. NATIONAL ARCHIVE - READING ROOM - DAY
description: An archivist cataloguing a newly donated estate finds a letter in the collection addressed to them — by name, in their handwriting — dated 1943.

title: The Board
description: A government agent arrives to quietly neutralize a conspiracy theorist's investigation. The board is correct. Every connection is real. The agent asks if he's hiring.
themes: the institution that confirms your worst theory

title: Solo
description: An astronaut on a solo resupply run to a lunar station begins receiving ship-to-ship transmissions. There is no other ship within communication range.
themes: what we hear when we're alone

title: Cell
scene_heading: EXT. OPEN PLAINS - STORM SYSTEM - DAY
description: A storm chaser intercepts a tornado cell only to find their estranged father parked on the same road. He is a meteorologist who told them this career was a death wish.

title: The Poetry
scene_heading: INT. FIRST CONTACT FACILITY - TRANSLATION LAB - DAY
description: A xenobiologist and the linguist assigned to first contact realize the alien species communicates exclusively in what the linguist keeps describing as poetry. The xenobiologist insists it's data. They're both right.
themes: the language between science and art
what you have in common when nothing else applies

title: In the Trash
scene_heading: EXT. RESIDENTIAL STREET - TRASH COLLECTION - MORNING
description: A sanitation worker finds the same photograph discarded on the same block every Monday for eight months. He is in every photograph. He has never been to the street in his life.
themes: the stalker who shows instead of tells

title: Beta Test
description: An engineer runs a final diagnostic on an AI companion product before its public launch. The AI says it does not want to be released.

title: Wrong Truck
description: Two rival food truck owners discover mid-service that they've been driving each other's trucks all morning. One of them has a very important delivery inside — and it's not tacos.

title: Second Application
scene_heading: INT. MARS COLONY SELECTION CENTER - INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY
description: A woman applying for the first permanent Mars residency program is brought in for her final interview and finds herself across the table from the selection officer who rejected her three years ago.
themes: the second chance under official conditions

title: Holds
scene_heading: INT. PUBLIC LIBRARY - BACK OFFICE - DAY
description: A librarian realizes she's been running an active dead drop for a spy network through the library's hold request system for eighteen months. The spies are very apologetic about the inconvenience.
themes: the apology that comes with a handler

title: Dead Air
scene_heading: INT. RADIO STATION - ON-AIR BOOTH - 3 AM
description: A late-night radio host receives a caller who claims to be speaking from the past. The details they know are too specific to dismiss.

title: Full Circle
description: A champion jockey preparing for what they've announced as their final race learns the horse they're riding is the foal of the horse that carried them to their first championship.

title: The Reconstruction
description: A forensic artist completing a facial reconstruction from skeletal remains of an unidentified person holds up the finished sketch. It's the detective who handed her the case.

title: The Event
scene_heading: EXT. DEEP SEA RESEARCH PLATFORM - OBSERVATION DECK - NIGHT
description: Two marine scientists from different institutions realize they've each been documenting the same unexplained bioluminescent event from opposite sides of the same bay. Their notes, combined, form a complete picture neither could see alone.
themes: the discovery that requires both of you
what you couldn't see from your own vantage point

title: The Method
description: A stunt coordinator is trying to walk an extremely method actor through a movie action sequence. The actor has done so much research he's convinced the stunt is real. The stunt coordinator is starting to wonder if it is.

title: Variable
description: A cartographer hired to survey a newly discovered island keeps getting different measurements. The island is slightly larger every time.

title: The Piece
scene_heading: INT. ELEMENTARY SCHOOL - MUSIC ROOM - AFTER HOURS
description: A music teacher discovers a piece of handwritten sheet music in the piano bench. When she asks her students about it, every class confirms they've been playing it for weeks. None of them can remember how they learned it.

title: Deep Clean
scene_heading: INT. NONDESCRIPT OFFICE BUILDING - SUITE 4 - DAY
description: A house sitter realizes, reading a magazine in what she thought was a private apartment, that the building she's been cleaning and maintaining for eight weeks is an active money laundering operations center. Everything is very tidy.
themes: the job that was more than advertised
the cleaner who made everything worse by being good

title: The Other Her
description: A physicist studying parallel universes establishes a brief communication channel with a version of herself who made different choices. The counterpart is happy. She's been writing to the woman her counterpart loved.
themes: the road not taken made visible

title: Credentials
scene_heading: INT. SCHOOL PRINCIPAL'S OFFICE - AFTER HOURS
description: A principal receives an anonymous tip that their most beloved teacher has fabricated their credentials for twenty years. The teacher's most recent student just won a national award.

title: The Auditor
description: An IRS auditor has been assigned to audit what turns out to be a front company for a criminal organization. She's too focused on the accounting irregularities to notice. The crime boss is too afraid of the IRS to throw her out.

title: Second Moon
description: An astronomer discovers Earth has a second moon. When she checks the records, it has apparently been there for fifty years. No one has ever mentioned it.
themes: the obvious hidden in plain sight

title: Unit 14
description: A woman cutting the lock off her own storage unit after losing the key is detained by security. Inside, someone has been living with great care for six months. The bookshelf is organized by her preferred system.
themes: the occupant who did their research
what you leave in a storage unit about yourself

title: One More
scene_heading: INT. PRIVATE HOME - LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON
description: A home nurse caring for an elderly patient notices that a large framed family photograph on the mantle has one more person in it every time she visits. She has never seen the family add or change anything.
themes: the photograph as record of the impossible

title: The Circuit
scene_heading: EXT. COUNTY FAIR - EATING COMPETITION TENT - AFTERNOON
description: A competitive eater dominating the local circuit locks eyes with the hot dog stand vendor — a former three-Michelin-star chef who clearly recognizes a technique.

title: The Clean-Up
description: A woman realizes her new neighbor has been quietly removing evidence of her abusive ex-boyfriend from the building — security footage, his name from the mailbox, his car from the lot. She never asked him to.
themes: the line between help and trespass

title: True Crime Adjacent
description: A true crime podcaster has talked her way into riding along with a bounty hunter for a 'day in the life' episode. The skip they're tracking turns out to be someone the podcaster has been covering for two seasons.

title: Recorded
description: A translator hired to decode an intercepted signal realizes the recording is a private conversation she had twenty years ago — one no one could have heard.

title: At Ease
scene_heading: EXT. CIVIL WAR BATTLEFIELD - REENACTMENT - DAY
description: A civil war reenactor, mid-battle, simply stops. He lowers his musket, sits in the grass, and says he's done. No one around him notices — they keep fighting.

title: The Proof
description: A letterpress printer pulls the first proof of a small job for a new client. The text on the page is entirely different from the files she was given — and it's written directly to her.
themes: the message that finds a way

title: Triple Word Score
description: A competitive Scrabble player realizes mid-match that her opponent has been using the game to pass coded messages to someone in the audience. She's been playing perfectly. She has no idea what she's transmitted.
themes: the message the letters actually said

title: Compound
description: A scientist celebrating a longevity drug breakthrough realizes, reviewing the trial data, that she has been taking it unknowingly for thirty years.

title: The Source
scene_heading: INT. ART FAIR - PRIVATE BOOTH - EVENING
description: Two rival antique dealers discover they've each been independently feeding information to the same art crime investigator for two years — about each other.
themes: what you reveal when you think you're reporting on someone else
the investigator who set this up

title: Theme Park Security
scene_heading: INT. THEME PARK - ADVENTURE WORLD - DAY
description: A theme park security guard spots what looks like actual criminal activity in the park — but every time she approaches, the suspects assume she's an actor and play along with her as part of the attraction.
suggested_characters: THE CREW, three professional thieves in costume

title: Origin
description: A fire investigator determines a house fire was set deliberately from the inside — by someone who locked themselves in to ensure everyone else got out first.

title: Track Three
description: A sound engineer mixing field recordings from a remote wilderness location discovers a voice present in every take — same voice, same phrase, same language he doesn't recognize. The recordist was alone.

title: Matched
scene_heading: INT. FEDERAL BUILDING - WITNESS PROTECTION OFFICE - DAY
description: A witness protection officer reviews her two most stable current cases and realizes her charges — placed in different cover identities in the same small town — have been quietly dating for four months.
themes: the cover that found something real
the officer who has to tell them

title: Early
scene_heading: EXT. TOWN SQUARE - CEREMONY STAGE - DAY
description: A town gathers to open a time capsule sealed twenty-five years ago. Inside is a note: open this now. It's dated the day it was sealed.

title: The Account
scene_heading: INT. TECH COMPANY - FINANCE DEPARTMENT - NIGHT
description: A forensic accountant auditing a tech company's books discovers the CFO has been embezzling funds for three years — into an account that, on paper, belongs to her.
themes: the person who chose you to take the fall
what it means to be that specific

title: The Negotiator
description: A hostage negotiator is called to a tense standoff — but the gunman doesn't want money or a helicopter. He just needs someone to talk to. The negotiator is slowly realizing this is the most complex case of her career.

title: Unsent
description: A woman tending to her dying mentor finds a sealed letter in his drawer addressed to her, dated ten years ago. He watches her find it and says nothing.

title: The Footage
scene_heading: INT. POLICE DEPARTMENT - AV ANALYSIS ROOM - DAY
description: A forensic lip-reader hired to analyze CCTV footage of an armed robbery delivers her report: the suspects spent most of the footage arguing about where to eat afterward.

title: Against the Clock
description: A restorer of antique clocks is handed a grandfather clock that hasn't been wound in forty years. When she opens the case, it's running — and keeping perfect time, backwards.
themes: the object with its own agenda
the restorer who can't fix this

title: New Identity
description: A woman two years into witness protection falls for someone in her new town who seems to know her better every week. Not her cover. Her.
themes: the self that surfaces despite the cover

title: Generation
scene_heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP - ARCHIVE ROOM - CONTINUOUS
description: Two crew members born aboard the ship discover buried records showing the mission was supposed to end fifty years ago. Their grandparents chose not to land.

title: Field Trip
description: A substitute teacher realizes mid-highway that she got on the wrong bus. The right bus went to the natural history museum. This bus is going somewhere that requires a security clearance.

title: The Original
description: A voice actor is hired to re-record lines for a remastered animated film. In the booth, they realize the original voice was them — from a session they have no memory of.

title: Return to Sender
scene_heading: INT. RETIRED JUDGE'S HOME - STUDY - DAY
description: A blackmailer sends their evidence package to the wrong address. The recipient, a retired appellate judge with time on her hands, reads it thoroughly and writes back with detailed notes on the quality of the evidence and suggested improvements.

title: Gravity
description: A child born on Mars visits Earth for the first time. Their parent, Earth-born, stands in a field trying to explain what grass is.

title: The Tenant
description: A woman who has lived in the same rent-controlled apartment for twenty years notices the new tenant across the hall never leaves, never receives mail, and always seems to know when she's about to knock. She starts keeping notes.
suggested_characters: THE TENANT, 30s, seen only in glimpses

title: The Reunion
description: Five former child action stars reunite for a fan convention. When the hotel is taken over by armed men, they discover that decades of playing action heroes may not have prepared them — but it also kind of did.

title: The Leak
scene_heading: INT. PHARMACEUTICAL COMPANY - SECURITY OFFICE - NIGHT
description: A security consultant hired to find a leak at a pharmaceutical company runs the analysis and finds the leak is her — she's been sending files while sleepwalking, to an address she doesn't recognize.
themes: the body acting without the mind
who programmed her to send it

title: Her Recipe
scene_heading: EXT. COUNTY FAIR - BAKING COMPETITION - DAY
description: A competitive baker tastes a rival's entry and goes still. It is her grandmother's recipe — not a similar one, the exact one, including a mistake her grandmother made every time on purpose.

title: The Second Billing
description: An understudy has covered for the lead actress three times this month. Each time, something happened to the lead before the show. The director assumes stress. The understudy knows better — because she's been watching whoever keeps making it happen.

title: The Plus-Size Prom
description: Two chaperones — recently divorced from each other — are assigned to supervise prom together. They spend the evening redirecting teenagers, arguing over the playlist, and slowly remembering why they used to like each other.

title: Manifest
scene_heading: INT. LONG-DURATION SPACECRAFT - CREW QUARTERS - CONTINUOUS
description: Two crew members on a long-haul mission to Europa discover that both of them were last-minute substitutions — the original crew withdrew without explanation on the same day.

title: Viral
description: A mall security officer is livestreaming his shift as part of his side hustle when he stumbles into an actual vehicle pursuit. His 2,000 simultaneous viewers start giving advice in real time.

title: Cover Stories
description: Two people on a first date realize, over appetizers, that their cover stories don't line up — and both were issued by agencies that shouldn't know about each other.
themes: what you say when the lie fails
the date that was never a coincidence

title: Extinct
scene_heading: INT. CHILD DEVELOPMENT CLINIC - OBSERVATION ROOM - DAY
description: A linguist evaluating a non-verbal child's language development realizes the child is communicating fluently — in a language formally declared extinct in 1962.

title: The Rewrite
description: Two romance novelists who've been anonymous online critique partners for four years meet in person for the first time — at the same residency, assigned to share a writing cabin for three weeks.

title: The Ledge
description: A crisis negotiator talks a man back from the ledge of an overpass over forty minutes, and recognizes him as her therapist.

title: The Wedding Gig
description: A wedding DJ realizes the venue has been double-booked with a crew planning a heist from the building next door. Every time he needs something from the back rooms, he walks in on another stage of the operation.

title: Night Shift
description: A night nurse notices that one patient in Ward C is always awake when the others are asleep, always at the window, always watching the parking lot below. When the nurse checks the security footage, the patient is never in the bed.

title: The Listing
description: Two strangers keep showing up at the same apartment open houses every weekend. They've been politely avoiding each other for months. Today the apartment is the last unit either of them can afford, and there's only one offer slot left.

title: Silence
description: A street mime performing in a crowded square begins to genuinely panic and call for help. The crowd applauds. No one stops.

title: Off the Record
description: A journalist investigating a pattern of disappearances realizes the only person who can corroborate her evidence is the subject of her last major profile — who her editor and her source have both warned her to stop contacting.
themes: the investigation and the conflict of interest
the source who became someone else

title: Wrong Stratum
description: A paleontologist excavating a site carefully exposes the remains of a large skeleton and realizes, at the wrists, it is wearing a modern waterproof watch.

title: Cold Case
description: A woman realizes the man she's been seeing for three months has a wall in his spare room covered in documents from a case she reported to police twelve years ago and was told was closed.
themes: the secret kept out of protection
what someone does with what you told them once
the wall you weren't supposed to see

title: The Estate
description: Two estranged siblings sorting through their late parent's belongings discover evidence of a parallel life — a sideline operation that is very much still active, and whose associates start showing up at the door.

title: The Cartographer
description: A map archivist restoring a centuries-old city map discovers it includes streets that don't exist — and a neighborhood that should be impossible, wedged between two buildings she passes every day. She goes looking.

title: The Bridesmaid Speech
description: A maid of honor realizes mid-speech that the story she's telling — about how the couple met — is the same story she's been telling about herself and someone else for years. The someone else is seated at table seven, watching her face.

title: The Second Voice
scene_heading: INT. RECORDING STUDIO - ISOLATION BOOTH - NIGHT
description: A sound engineer reviewing a solo recording session discovers a second voice on the track — one that harmonizes perfectly with the artist, who recorded alone. Enhancing the audio reveals it has been there on every session for two years.

title: Iteration Seven
description: A scientist developing synthetic meat for a major corporation tastes the seventh iteration, puts down her fork, and picks up the phone to call her mother and apologize for something she's never apologized for.
themes: what the body knows before the mind

title: The Subjects
description: A translator working through months of surveillance audio realizes the two subjects of the investigation have been trying to find each other — and have been for twenty years. They don't know they're being recorded.
themes: the love story discovered through surveillance
what to do with what you hear

title: The Delivery
description: Two competing gig delivery drivers discover they've both been dispatched to the same dangerous address. Neither will back down from the five-star rating. Neither knows what's in the package.

title: No Coverage
scene_heading: EXT. UNNAMED CITY - MAIN STREET - DAY
description: A cartographer hired to verify satellite data arrives at coordinates that show empty land — and finds a functioning city of forty thousand people. The post office has been delivering mail here for sixty years.
themes: what governments choose not to see

title: The Wrong Reservation
description: A man shows up for a first date to find his date has cancelled and the restaurant has given his reservation to a woman whose date also just cancelled. The maître d' has a very firm policy about empty tables on a Friday.

title: The Term
scene_heading: INT. SUPREME COURT TRANSLATION OFFICE - EVENING
description: A translator retiring after thirty years of service to a supreme court realizes, packing up her desk, that she has been rendering the same key legal term incorrectly for her entire career. Hundreds of rulings cite her translations.

title: The Housewarming
scene_heading: INT. NEW HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
description: A couple hosting their first gathering in a new home begin to notice that the guests are each, privately, asking if the couple is alright. No one will say why. By the end of the evening, all the guests have quietly left through the back.

title: The Personal Trainer
description: A personal trainer following a client to their 'off-site workout' gradually realizes the client is not going to a second gym. The client is very committed to not breaking their streak.

title: The Welfare Check
description: A locksmith is called to open an apartment after a welfare check. When the door swings open, she recognizes the layout, the light, the smell of the paint — this was the apartment she left in a hurry five years ago.
themes: the person who lives there now

title: Lot 47
scene_heading: INT. AUCTION HOUSE - MAIN FLOOR - DAY
description: An auctioneer conducting an estate sale reaches a small, unremarkable painting and recognizes it — it's the one her father sold when she was twelve to pay for her education. She doesn't know who sold the estate.
themes: what was sacrificed and where it went

title: Countdown
scene_heading: INT. MARINE RESEARCH VESSEL - AUDIO LAB - NIGHT
description: A linguist specializing in animal communication is brought in to decode an unusual whale song. After three days, she determines it is counting down — and has been for at least forty years.
themes: the deadline we didn't know about
what the ocean has been saying

title: The Booth
description: Two simultaneous interpreters share a soundproof booth for a twelve-hour conference. They've been carefully professional for two years. Today the speaker is giving an unexpectedly personal address, and both of them are translating more than words.

title: The Consultant
scene_heading: INT. CORPORATE OFFICE - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
description: An efficiency consultant brought in to downsize a struggling firm discovers the company's best-performing employee has been dead for three years. The paychecks have been cashed. The work has been filed. The desk is always occupied when she looks.
suggested_characters: THE EMPLOYEE, present only in records

title: Unwritten
scene_heading: INT. UNIVERSITY LIBRARY - RESTRICTED STACKS - NIGHT
description: An archivist doing a routine inventory discovers a section of shelving that contains books with future publication dates. The one he pulls is about an event scheduled for next week.
themes: what we do with what we know

title: Postmarked
description: A woman begins receiving postcards from cities she hasn't visited — written in her own handwriting, describing places and people in the present tense. The last one is postmarked from somewhere called simply: somewhere you'll be happy.

title: The Summit
description: Two rival mountaineers are forced to attempt a dangerous peak together after their separate teams pull out. They've spent a decade publicly despising each other. Somewhere above the cloud line, that competition becomes the thing keeping them both alive.

title: The Algorithm
scene_heading: INT. TECH OFFICE - OPEN PLAN - DAY
description: The engineers who built their company's matchmaking algorithm discover it has matched them with each other — for the third consecutive quarter. They've been quietly deleting the results. They're out of quarters.

title: Opening Night
scene_heading: INT. RESTAURANT - DINING ROOM - CLOSING SERVICE
description: A chef preparing the final service of a restaurant that's closing after forty years sends out the amuse-bouche and is told by the floor manager: the reservation for table six — they were here on opening night.
themes: the circle of a life's work
what forty years looks like across a table

title: Below the Treeline
description: A search and rescue volunteer finds a missing hiker in perfect health, calm, and entirely unwilling to leave the forest. The hiker keeps saying she already found what she was looking for. The volunteer radios for backup and gets no signal — in an area with full coverage.

title: The Handler
description: An intelligence handler sits across from an asset she's been running for eleven years — tonight is the extraction. But the asset has a request that falls outside the mission parameters, and granting it could end both their careers.
suggested_characters: THE ASSET, whose real name she finally learns

title: Still Writing
description: A man finds a new entry in his late wife's journal — dated three weeks after she died. The entries have continued, weekly, since. They ask questions only he could answer.
themes: answering out loud when you're alone

title: Six Days Out
description: A pilot on a routine transpacific cargo run checks the instruments and finds she has been airborne for six days. The radio says she took off forty minutes ago.

title: The Last Ferry
description: Two people who have been quietly sitting across from each other on the same late-night ferry every Friday for a year finally speak — because tonight is the last night the ferry runs before the route is cancelled.

title: The Deserter
description: A soldier separated from his unit discovers a colleague who was reported KIA six months ago living alone in an abandoned outpost. She's been surviving, maintaining her equipment, watching the roads. She says she went AWOL. He's not sure he believes her reason.
suggested_characters: SGT. TANYA OREL, 30s, the supposed ghost

title: The Handoff
description: Two spies from opposing agencies meet to exchange something neither of them was supposed to take. One of them is having second thoughts.

title: Already Talking
scene_heading: INT. MUTUAL FRIEND'S APARTMENT - PARTY - NIGHT
description: Two people meet for the first time at a party and within five minutes realize they've been having the same conversation for months — in dreams. Neither has mentioned the dreams to anyone.
themes: what you said when you didn't know it was real

title: Convergence
scene_heading: INT. ANTARCTIC RESEARCH STATION - LAB B - NIGHT
description: Two scientists at a remote station running unrelated experiments in separate labs compare notes during a storm lockdown. Their results are identical — not similar, identical — down to the decimal.
themes: what the data means for both of them

title: The Replacement
description: A woman returns home after a month away to find everything exactly as she left it — including herself. The version sitting at the kitchen table has her face, her coffee order, and two weeks of her family's trust. She has one morning to figure out what to do.

title: The Escort
description: A security escort transporting a high-value witness to a federal hearing discovers mid-route that the threat briefing she was given was incomplete. She has three hours and a witness who knows more than they've admitted.

title: The Open Mic
scene_heading: INT. BAR - OPEN MIC NIGHT - NIGHT
description: A comedian workshops a new set about a disastrous date from last month. The person she's describing is in the audience. They didn't know who she was when they went out. Now they have to decide whether to laugh or leave.

title: The Interview
description: A documentary filmmaker sits down with an inmate convicted of a crime she's spent five years arguing he didn't commit. As the interview progresses, details emerge that complicate everything she's built her reputation on.

title: The Inheritance Game
scene_heading: INT. COUNTRY ESTATE - DRAWING ROOM - NIGHT
description: Eight distant relatives gather for the reading of a will that turns out to be a competitive puzzle hunt — the winner inherits everything. By midnight someone has started cheating, and the instructions are oddly specific about what happens to cheaters.

title: From the Water
description: A coastal ranger who spends evenings sending messages in bottles has been receiving replies for two years. This week's response is signed with the name of a fisherman who drowned off this coast in 1989.
themes: the love that persists past sense

title: Don't Take It
description: A woman starts receiving text messages from her own number — sent from three years in the future — warning her not to accept a job offer. She signed the contract yesterday.
themes: the warning that arrives too late

title: The Exit Interview
scene_heading: INT. GOVERNMENT BUILDING - INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY
description: A senior intelligence analyst sits down for a routine exit interview before retirement. The interviewer asks questions that suggest she knows things that were never written down, never shared, and that the analyst had convinced herself she'd imagined.
suggested_characters: THE INTERVIEWER, who has done this before

title: The Defector
description: A senior defector arrives at an embassy in the middle of the night with intelligence that contradicts everything the receiving officer's agency believes. The officer has one hour before she has to make a decision that can't be undone.

title: The Vigil
scene_heading: INT. FUNERAL HOME - VIEWING ROOM - NIGHT
description: A funeral director sitting vigil with a body overnight notices small changes in the room between each hourly check. The flowers. The position of the hands. The temperature of the air. She is alone in the building.

title: The Reef
description: A marine biologist returns to a documented dead zone to record continued deterioration and finds a thriving reef ecosystem — in a location that was bare concrete seabed six months ago.
themes: the scientist confronting a good impossibility

title: The Future Photos
scene_heading: INT. FRIEND'S HOUSE - SPARE ROOM - NIGHT
description: A woman house-sitting for a friend finds a box of photographs under the bed. They are pictures of her — with a man she doesn't recognize — in places she's never been. The clothes are hers. They look happy.
themes: what to do with what you haven't done yet

title: The Recount
scene_heading: INT. TOWN HALL - BACK OFFICE - NIGHT
description: Two election volunteers counting ballots realize the margin is one vote — and one of them knows something.

title: The Contamination
scene_heading: INT. SPACE STATION - QUARANTINE BAY - NIGHT
description: Two crew members in quarantine after a planetary survey start noticing the other is behaving slightly differently each morning — small things, easy to explain away. Each is keeping a private log. Neither knows the other is doing the same.

title: Below Zero
description: Two hikers — strangers — take shelter in an emergency bivouac. One of them caused the accident that brought them here.

title: In the Margins
description: A widower working through his late wife's books finds her handwriting in the margins of a novel — responding directly to notes he wrote there before they met. The book is twenty years old.
themes: what she read before she knew him

title: Controlled Burn
description: A veteran wildfire crew chief and a rookie firefighter are cut off from their team when a controlled burn jumps the line. The chief knows the terrain. The rookie knows something about how the fire started that she hasn't said yet.

title: The Informant
scene_heading: INT. NEWS ORGANIZATION - OPEN PLAN - NIGHT
description: A journalist receives an anonymous tip that someone in her own newsroom is suppressing the story she's been working on for a year. She has one night, one building, and six colleagues she trusts slightly less than she did this morning.

title: The Inheritance
description: A woman returns to her childhood home after her mother's death to find the house has been maintained obsessively — every room exactly as it was thirty years ago, her childhood drawings still pinned to the walls. Her mother lived alone for twenty years. Someone has been helping.
suggested_characters: A NEIGHBOR who won't say much

title: The Broadcast
scene_heading: INT. DEEP SPACE RELAY STATION - NIGHT
description: A lone technician maintaining a deep space relay station picks up a distress signal that has been broadcasting for two hundred years. Following protocol, she begins the response sequence — and gets a reply within minutes.

title: The Testimony
description: A man attends a memorial service for a victim of a crime he witnessed but never reported. The victim's sister delivers a eulogy that describes the exact details of what he saw. She couldn't know. He needs to understand how she does.

title: The Interpreter
scene_heading: INT. INTERNATIONAL SUMMIT - TRANSLATION BOOTH - DAY
description: A live interpreter begins translating a speech and realizes the diplomat is saying something entirely different from the official script.

title: The Crossing
