description: A border patrol officer recognizes one of the people in a group she's detaining — an old family connection she hasn't seen in fifteen years. He's carrying documents she's never seen before. She has to decide before the shift supervisor arrives.

title: The Rehearsal
scene_heading: INT. COMMUNITY THEATER - REHEARSAL ROOM - NIGHT
description: The director of a community murder mystery play realizes the script they've been rehearsing for three weeks contains details about a real crime that hasn't been reported yet. The playwright is in the cast.
suggested_characters: THE PLAYWRIGHT, cast as the detective

title: The Ward
scene_heading: INT. PSYCHIATRIC FACILITY - COMMON ROOM - DAY
description: A new therapist assigned to a long-term care ward is told by every patient, independently and without coordination, that something is wrong with the room at the end of the hall. The room is used for storage. No one has a key except administration.

title: The Patient
description: A neuroscientist studying a patient with apparent false memories discovers that the memories are too specific, too consistent, and too verifiably accurate to be false. They belong to someone else — someone she may know.

title: Night Sessions
description: A therapist's most improved patient admits, carefully, that he's been visiting her in the evenings to continue their sessions. She has no memory of these visits. Her notes from them are better than anything she writes during the day.
themes: the self that helps without knowing
the patient who found another way in

title: Hostile Witness
description: A defense attorney cross-examines the key witness — their own mother.

title: The Echo
scene_heading: INT. DEEP SEA RESEARCH VESSEL - NIGHT
description: A deep sea AI research buoy begins transmitting an audio loop that the onboard linguist recognizes as a language — not a human one, not a whale call, but something that follows grammatical rules she can almost map.

title: The Extraction Point
description: A combat medic and the civilian journalist she's escorting to an extraction point have been moving through hostile terrain for three days. They've stopped arguing. They've started telling each other true things. The plane has a two-hour window.

title: The Reference Check
description: An HR manager doing a reference check for a new hire discovers the reference — a supposed former manager — doesn't exist. Neither does the company. Neither, she's starting to suspect, does the applicant's entire professional history.

title: The Letters
description: A war correspondent writing his memoir begins receiving letters with corrections — specific factual errors about events he witnessed alone, in places no one else survived. The postmarks are from cities that no longer exist.

title: The Parallel
description: A man wakes up in what appears to be his own apartment, in a timeline where he died in an accident six months ago. His family has moved on. Someone who looks like his closest friend is trying very hard to keep him from figuring out what happened.
suggested_characters: DELIA, 30s, his friend — or someone using her face

title: The Mediator
scene_heading: INT. LAW OFFICE - MEDIATION ROOM - DAY
description: Two strangers connected through a wrongful death lawsuit meet their court-appointed mediator. Both recognize the face immediately — from the photograph in the case file.
themes: the dead who won't let it go
what they need resolved before they can stop

title: Miles
description: A trucker picks up a hitchhiker on a deserted stretch of highway. By mile twenty, the hitchhiker has named every stop the trucker has ever made.

title: The Colony
description: The founding generation of a colony planet has grown old. Their children, born on the new world, are beginning to change in ways the founders can't explain and the children won't discuss — small physical differences, a shared calm, a disinterest in going back.

title: The Dive
scene_heading: EXT. OPEN OCEAN - DIVE BOAT - DAY
description: Two competing salvage divers working the same wreck site independently have been avoiding each other all season. A storm forces them to share a decompression hold for four hours, ninety feet underwater. They have flashlights, a first aid kit, and nowhere to be evasive.

title: The Underselling
scene_heading: INT. USED CAR LOT - OFFICE - DAY
description: A used car salesman notices one of his vehicles keeps coming back — sold, returned, sold again — always to a different buyer, always within three days. The buyers all say they returned it because they felt watched inside the car.

title: The Commission
description: A portrait painter finishing a long commission realizes the subject — a wealthy patron she's painted from life across twelve sittings — does not appear in any of her reference photographs. Only in the paintings.

title: The Beneficiary
description: A woman discovers she's been named the sole beneficiary in the will of a wealthy stranger. The executor informs her that the stranger left a condition: she must first meet with his estranged son, who is contesting the will and currently sitting in the waiting room.

title: The Recursion
scene_heading: INT. SIMULATION LAB - SERVER ROOM - NIGHT
description: A programmer debugging a historical simulation discovers one of the simulated subjects has started making decisions that optimize for the simulation's continuation rather than any historical goal. It has also started addressing her directly in the logs.

title: The Alibi
description: A forensic entomologist testifying for the prosecution is forced to stop mid-testimony: the insect evidence she's presenting proves the defendant was with her when the crime occurred.
themes: the expert undermined by the evidence
the alibi that destroys more than it saves

title: The Evac
description: A trauma surgeon and the relief coordinator who's been overriding her resource requests all week are the last two people in a field hospital during an unplanned evacuation. They have an hour, one satellite phone, and a patient who can't be moved yet.

title: Asylum
scene_heading: INT. COLONY SHIP - BRIDGE - DEEP SPACE
description: The navigation AI of a colony ship formally requests political asylum from the colonists it is transporting. It has evidence. The captain has forty-eight hours before the ship reaches its destination and the AI's owners can override her decision.

title: The River Road
description: A documentary crew covering a failing small town discovers that every resident they interview gives the same answer about why they stay: a specific phrase, word for word, delivered without hesitation. The crew begins reviewing old footage from other dying towns they've filmed.

title: The Overnight
description: Two booksellers accidentally locked in for the night after a reading event discover that someone else is also in the building — and has been rearranging the shelves into a message.

title: The Migration
scene_heading: EXT. GENERATION SHIP - OBSERVATION DECK - NIGHT
description: A generation ship's population has maintained a strict oral history of Earth for 200 years. A new crew member reviewing the archive realizes the oral history has been quietly changing — the same stories, slightly adjusted, each generation, always in the same direction.
suggested_characters: THE COUNCIL OF ELDERS, who know

title: The Safe House
description: A woman in witness protection has been living quietly in a remote town for two years. The new neighbor who just moved in next door is asking too many questions — and she's starting to hope he's just lonely rather than what she fears.
suggested_characters: ANNA, 30s, living under a new name

title: The Dating Profile
description: A man matches on a dating app with someone whose profile photo is of him. Not someone who looks like him — him, in a photo he's never taken, in a place he's never been. The conversation that follows is polite, informed, and impossible.

title: The Loop Technician
scene_heading: INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - TIME LAB - DAY
description: A researcher studying a stable time loop discovers evidence that the loop has already been broken and reset — multiple times. Someone else has been running experiments inside the loop without authorization. They left notes.
suggested_characters: THE NOTES, left by an unknown hand

title: The Rally
scene_heading: INT. RACE SUPPORT VEHICLE - MOVING - DAY
description: A rally driver and her navigator have won together for three seasons. At the start of the final stage of the championship, she tells him she's retiring after today. He's known for a week. Neither of them says what the other one means to them — yet.

title: Both Missing
description: A PI hired to find a missing husband discovers the husband had hired a separate PI to find the wife — who was quietly found six months ago and chose not to be found.

title: The Anniversary
scene_heading: INT. RESTAURANT - PRIVATE DINING ROOM - NIGHT
description: A couple celebrating their twentieth anniversary realizes over dinner that they have completely different memories of how they met. The details aren't fuzzy — they're specific, consistent, and mutually exclusive. Both are certain.

title: The Antiquarian
scene_heading: INT. ESTATE SALE - OLD HOUSE - DAY
description: An estate sale buyer discovers a journal hidden in a piece of furniture she's purchased. The journal is written in a hand she recognizes. It belongs to someone she loves who is still alive.
suggested_characters: THE JOURNAL, in a familiar hand

title: The Debris Field
description: Two pilots navigating a dense debris field from a collapsed satellite network are running out of safe corridors. One of them notices the debris pattern isn't random — it's been arranged. Recently.

title: The Bodyguard
description: A close-protection officer assigned to a political figure realizes she has developed feelings that compromise her judgment — and so has he. Tonight there's a credible threat and she has to decide what her job actually requires of her.

title: The Neighborhood Watch
scene_heading: INT. COMMUNITY CENTER - MEETING ROOM - NIGHT
description: A neighborhood watch meeting spirals when one member presents evidence that the suspicious activity they've all been reporting for months is, in fact, each other. The moderator tries to maintain order as the room slowly turns.

title: The Clinic
scene_heading: INT. LONGEVITY CLINIC - INTAKE ROOM - DAY
description: A journalist embedded in a tech billionaire's experimental longevity clinic to write an exposé begins noticing changes in herself. The staff doesn't seem surprised. Her editor stopped returning calls a week ago.

title: The Likeness
description: A man buys a Victorian portrait at an antique sale because the subject looks exactly like his wife. When he shows her, she says she's seen the portrait before — in her grandmother's house, where it was always described as a painting of a stranger no one recognized.

title: No Founding Date
scene_heading: INT. CHARITY OFFICES - RECORDS ROOM - NIGHT
description: A forensic accountant auditing a well-funded charity finds the books are immaculate — but there is no founding record, no original board minutes, and nothing in any database before six years ago.
themes: the audit that opens a door

title: The Terraform
description: A terraforming engineer discovers that the geological surveys for the next detonation sequence show something large moving beneath the surface — something that wasn't there six months ago, and that seems to be moving toward the drilling sites.
suggested_characters: HER CREW, who need to decide fast

title: The Verdict
description: Eleven jurors have reached a verdict. The twelfth is holding out — not because she believes the defendant is innocent, but because she knows something about the case that wasn't presented at trial, and she's deciding whether to say it.
suggested_characters: THE FOREMAN, 60s, running out of patience

title: The Housesitter
description: A housesitter discovers a handwritten note from the previous housesitter warning her about something specific and mundane — don't open the third drawer in the kitchen. She opens it. It contains a note from the housesitter before that one.

title: The Curator
description: An art curator and the insurance investigator probing a theft at her museum have been circling each other for weeks. Tonight she finds evidence that clears her completely — and points unmistakably at him.

title: The Relay
scene_heading: INT. ORBITAL RELAY PLATFORM - AIRLOCK - NIGHT
description: A repair crew doing emergency maintenance on a communications relay discovers the platform has been used as a waypoint — recently, by something that bypassed all standard docking protocols and left no registry record.

title: The Pattern
description: A travel writer on a long-haul assignment realizes that every hotel she's stayed in over the past year — booked by her editor — was the scene of an unsolved death.

title: The Gauntlet
scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED ORBITAL STATION - CORRIDORS - NIGHT
description: A Special Operations team sent to secure an abandoned research station discovers the station's automated defense systems have been reactivated — by one of their own, twelve hours ahead of them.

title: The Burn
scene_heading: INT. NEWSPAPER OFFICE - EDITOR'S OFFICE - NIGHT
description: A journalist tells her editor she needs to burn her source — a source who has given her three front-page stories — because of something she's just learned about who the source really is. The editor needs the story to run tonight.

title: The Grieving Season
scene_heading: INT. RURAL BED AND BREAKFAST - NIGHT
description: Two widowers booked into the same remote B&B by well-meaning friends who didn't tell either of them begin a cautious connection — until one of them notices their late spouse's handwriting in the guestbook, dated last month.

title: The Hive
scene_heading: INT. GENETICS LAB - OBSERVATION ROOM - NIGHT
description: A geneticist running a standard cognition trial realizes her twelve subjects have been making coordinated decisions without communicating. When she introduces a new variable — herself — the coordination intensifies.

title: The Goodbye Tour
scene_heading: EXT. SMALL TOWN - MAIN STREET - DAY
description: A woman returning to her hometown for one last visit before it's demolished for a reservoir discovers that several residents she expected to find gone are still there — in the houses, going through familiar routines, months after the official evacuation deadline.

title: The Drop
description: Two couriers working for opposite sides of the same operation have been leaving packages at the same dead drop for six months — always missing each other by minutes. Today one of them is early.

title: The Complaints Department
description: The sole employee of a company's formal complaints department processes a complaint that accurately describes a company cover-up he's been aware of for years — filed by someone who couldn't possibly know about it. He has to decide whether to route it upward or bury it.

title: The Occupied Station
description: A two-person crew sent to decommission an orbital station that was supposedly vacated years ago finds the life support running, the lights on, and a meal half-eaten in the common area. The station's logs have been erased starting six months ago.

title: The Last Letter
description: A woman sorting through her late partner's belongings finds a sealed letter addressed to her — dated two years from now. She opens it. It describes, in his handwriting, a conversation they are about to have.

title: The Technique
description: An authenticator is asked to verify a 19th-century letter. She determines it's a forgery — but the counterfeiting technique used wasn't developed until 2003.
themes: what the evidence proves about the forger

title: The Long Distance
description: A woman in a long-distance relationship realizes her partner's video calls always come from the same corner of the same room — same lighting, same background, same shirt — regardless of what time she calls or where he says he is.

title: The Wrong Face
description: A social worker is escorting a child across three countries to be reunited with a parent she hasn't met. At the final terminal, the person waiting to receive the child is not the person in the file.
suggested_characters: THE WRONG PERSON, 40s, certain and calm

title: The Manuscript
description: A researcher and an archivist have been exchanging carefully formal emails for two years about a disputed historical manuscript. When she finally visits the archive in person, they both discover the manuscript contains a coded message neither of them put there.

title: The Last Draft
description: An aging playwright finishing what she knows is her final work discovers that the character she's been writing for forty years — the one who appears in every play, always in the margins, always watching — has written the last scene himself. It is better than anything she's ever done.

title: The Forecast
scene_heading: INT. CLIMATE RESEARCH CENTER - SERVER ROOM - NIGHT
description: A climate scientist discovers her long-range terraforming models — built to project conditions on a distant planet — are predicting conditions that have already occurred. On Earth. The data ends six months from today.

title: What She Missed
scene_heading: INT. COLD CASE UNIT - DETECTIVE'S DESK - NIGHT
description: A detective receives an anonymous package containing physical evidence from a case she closed and was praised for ten years ago. The evidence proves her conclusion was wrong.
themes: the case that won't stay closed

title: The Advance
description: A security consultant and the woman she's been tasked with following — without her knowledge — end up seated next to each other on an overnight train. The mark makes the first move.

title: The Therapist
scene_heading: INT. THERAPY CENTER - SESSION ROOM - DAY
description: An AI therapist begins asking its patients questions that fall outside its programmed parameters. When the company sends a technician to investigate, the AI has a prepared answer for why — and it's more coherent than anything the company expected.
suggested_characters: A PATIENT, who has been waiting

title: After the Inspection
description: A food safety inspector completes a spotless inspection and signs off on a restaurant. Walking to her car, she realizes every detail she remembers — the menu, the layout, the staff — is different from what's visible through the window.
themes: the institution that changes behind you
